eyebrow: For the Sales Director: business impact
code:
"The Executive Summary's Total Sales wasn't
 responding to the region filter. It's fixed and
 verified now. Company-wide totals, with no region
 selected, were accurate the whole time."
caption: Answers her real question — was anything I presented wrong — before she asks it.

eyebrow: For the Operations Manager: the real mechanism
code:
"Bound to Total Sales (All Regions), which uses
 CALCULATE with ALL(TerritoryDim) on purpose.
 Unfiltered, it matched the normal measure, which is
 why it wasn't caught. Rebound, renamed, validated."
caption: She reported it, and she'll be the one to notice if it happens again.
